policy.note: Official-source discovery only. Do not import, index for AI retrieval, redistribute, or label a text verified-current until the exact version, amendments, authoritative language and commercial/AI rights have been checked.

jurisdictions.candidateText: Constitution de la République du Burundi, promulgated 7 June 2018
jurisdictions.versionStatus: 2018 official text located; subsequent amendment/consolidation status requires verification
jurisdictions.notes: The Constitutional Court website also lists the Constitution under fundamental texts. Check the Official Gazette and later amendment notices; rights for commercial reproduction and AI retrieval have not been established.

jurisdictions.publisher: National Council for Law Reporting / Kenya Law
jurisdictions.versionStatus: Current publisher route located; confirm current consolidation and amendment cut-off in the source record
jurisdictions.notes: Kenya Law's current terms prohibit automated bulk extraction, commercial redistribution and AI/ML training without an explicit NCLR licensing agreement. The Presidential Library describes its archival 2010 copy as public domain, but that archival original is not a substitute for a verified current consolidated text. No full-text import or AI retrieval from Kenya Law until NCLR permissions are secured.

jurisdictions.publisher: Ministry of Justice / Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda
jurisdictions.candidateText: Constitution of the Republic of Rwanda (2023 revision), Official Gazette n° Special of 04/08/2023; trilingual official publication (Kinyarwanda, English, French); 176 Articles.
jurisdictions.versionStatus: Official Gazette text and matching Parliament-hosted copy located. RLRC identifies the Laws of Rwanda collection as updated daily and lists this Constitution under laws in force. Targeted 2024–2026 Gazette search did not locate a later constitutional amendment, but publisher confirmation and legal review of the current consolidated status remain required.
jurisdictions.notes: The Constitution appears in the Rwanda Law Reform Commission's current Laws of Rwanda collection, which RLRC says is updated daily. A matching Parliament-hosted Official Gazette copy confirms the trilingual text, date and 176-Article structure. Do not rely on repealed Law No. 31/2009 for copyright status: Law No. 055/2024 repealed it and its Article 282 now contains the relevant exclusion for official legislative texts and official translations. Keep the source inactive and commercialUseAllowed=false until local counsel/publisher confirms that this exclusion covers CARTA's full-text web/mobile display, indexing, AI retrieval and offline caching, and verifies no other applicable restriction.
jurisdictions.rightsBasisCandidate: Law N° 055/2024 of 20/06/2024, Article 282, published and effective 31/07/2024, excludes official legislative, administrative and judicial texts and official translations from copyright protection. This is a candidate statutory basis, not a final CARTA rights approval; counsel must confirm applicability to the exact official constitutional text and other relevant rights/terms.

jurisdictions.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs & Reconciliation; Office of the President; Office of the Prime Minister
jurisdictions.candidateText: 2026 Federal Constitution candidate; 2012 Provisional Federal Constitution and 2024-effective amendments are also referenced in official government pages
jurisdictions.notes: Official pages describe a 2026 Constitution approved in March 2026 and signed on 8 March 2026, while another official Prime Minister's Office page published in June 2026 describes amendments to the 2012 Provisional Constitution with an effective date of 30 March 2024. Do not choose or publish a current text until the Gazette, promulgation instrument, effective date and relationship between these instruments are reconciled by a qualified Somali legal reviewer.

jurisdictions.publisher: Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs, Republic of South Sudan
jurisdictions.candidateText: Transitional Constitution of the Republic of South Sudan, 2011
jurisdictions.versionStatus: Official Ministry page located; obtain and verify the latest consolidated text and amendment schedule
jurisdictions.notes: Do not assume the original 2011 text is the current consolidated text. Verify transitional amendments, commencement notices and any constitutional review instruments. Commercial and AI rights remain uncleared.

jurisdictions.publisher: Office of the Attorney General / Office of the Solicitor General / Parliament of Tanzania
jurisdictions.candidateText: Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania, 1977; Parliament page lists a 6 February 2025 upload
jurisdictions.versionStatus: Official publisher routes located; reconcile the 2025 parliamentary document with the OAG/OSG consolidated amendment history before import
jurisdictions.notes: The OSG e-Library record describes an English revised edition consolidating amendments only through the 14th Amendment of 2005. Do not treat that older copy as current without reconciling the Parliament 2025 document and subsequent amendments. Zanzibar's Constitution is a separate jurisdictional instrument and should be catalogued separately rather than merged into the Union Constitution.

jurisdictions.candidateText: Constitution of the Republic of Uganda, 1995, updated version
jurisdictions.versionStatus: ULRC record describes an updated Constitution; its subscription access and amendment cut-off need verification
jurisdictions.notes: The ULRC publication record identifies the text as updated but marks access as subscription. The ULII version is useful for cross-checking only; it is not the primary official publisher. The older government-hosted PDF should not be assumed to include every amendment.
